text: I don't have confirmed details showing that Smart money must be turned on to use Instant. As far as I know, they're separate features, and Instant eligibility depends mainly on things like your linked bank account and your income history. Eligibility and requirements can vary by account, so the most reliable check is the Instant section in the app, which shows whether you qualify and what's needed. If it says you're not eligible, our support team can look at your account and tell you exactly why.
